ValidationRule.description: To close a case that is classified as "Incidencia" with impact economic must have the following fields completed: Classification, Reason, Client Name (no BBVA internal), Asset, FO Deal Id,Notional,Deal currency, Actual SD, etc
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c, "GM"), SER_Incident_with_economic_impact__c = TRUE, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Subtype_GM__c )), ISBLANK(SER_Asset__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT(SER_Deal_Currency__c)), ISBLANK(SER_FO_Deal_Id__c ), ISBLANK(SER_Notional__c), ISBLANK(SER_Settlement_Date__c), ISBLANK(SER_Actual_SD__c), ISBLANK(TEXT (SER_Currency__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT (SER_Booking__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT (SER_Payer__c)), ISBLANK(SER_Amount_finally_assumed__c), ISBLANK(SER_Operational_risk__c), ISBLANK(TEXT (SER_SIRO_Account__c)), ISBLANK(SER_Accounting_date__c), ISBLANK(SER_Analysis__c), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId ) , AND(!ISBLANK(AccountId) ,Account.Name = "BBVA Internal Contact") ) ), OR( ISPICKVAL( SER_Booking__c, "BBVA Madrid"), ISBLANK(TEXT(SER_Office__c))),
OR( ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c, "Incidencia"), ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c, "Reclamación"), ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c, "Monetary claim") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed"), SER_Close__c = True ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close a case that is classified as "Incidencia" with impact economic must have the following fields completed: Classification, Reason, Client Name (no BBVA internal), Asset, FO Deal Id,Notional,Deal currency, Actual SD, etc
